flowchart TB
    subgraph CLIENT[Presentation]
        UI[React UI]
    end

    subgraph APIL[API layer]
        EP[FastAPI]
    end

    subgraph SAFE[Safety]
        G1[Pre guardrails]
        G2[Post stop-filter]
    end

    subgraph STG[Eight stages]
        S1[1 Enhance]
        S2[2 Retrieve]
        S3[3 CRAG]
        S4[4 Gate]
        S5[5 Compress]
        S6[6 Generate]
        S7[7 NLI]
        S8[8 Score]
    end

    subgraph DATA[Storage]
        V[(ChromaDB)]
        M[(BM25 cache)]
    end

    UI --> EP --> G1 --> S1 --> S2
    S2 --> V
    S2 --> M
    S2 --> S3 --> S4 --> S5 --> S6 --> G2 --> S7 --> S8 --> EP

    style CLIENT fill:#EBF5FB,stroke:#2980B9
    style APIL fill:#D6EAF8,stroke:#2980B9
    style SAFE fill:#FDEDEC,stroke:#E74C3C
    style STG fill:#EAF4EC,stroke:#27AE60
    style DATA fill:#FDF2E9,stroke:#E67E22
